// diagnostic

E1259

Couldn't build the sandbox's WASM Component.

What

Couldn't build the sandbox's WASM Component.

Why

Building a `target: sandbox` package shells out to `rustc --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` and `wasm-tools component embed`/`new` (D-DEP-WASM1=A); one of them is missing or failed.

Fix

Make sure `rustc` supports `wasm32-unknown-unknown` and `wasm-tools` is on PATH (both ship in the project's `nix develop` shell).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1259: tests/ui/sandbox_missing_wasm_tools_e1259.stderr.
